description: REQ-B6 mandates 'WHEN running aggregate Σ token_source==estimated / Σ all > 0.5 over last 100 rows, SHALL call self-recover.sh <slot> token-source-degraded <ratio>'. The roi.py module has the 2x penalty (line 14, 55-56) but NO degradation-ratio monitor; grep 'degraded|0\.5' against roi.py returns zero matches. group_j._HANDLER_BY_REASON does map 'token-source-degraded' → j9_measurement_recovery (line 104) but no producer ever raises that reason. REQ-B6 requirement is half-implemented: penalty exists, escalation pipeline exists in dispatcher, but the connector that observes the ratio and triggers the dispatcher is absent.

evidence.snippet: No reference to 'degraded', '0.5', 'last 100', or any aggregator. compute_token_cost_jpy returns a per-call cost; nothing tracks the running estimated/measured ratio.
